comments.label: Anyone can open an issue or comment. The issue reaches Claude only as the text a person with write access approved by adding the label, and only the comments of those GitHub says may write are passed on

Someone who may only triage can add a label too, so the start job asks GitHub about whoever last added it, and GitHub holds that, not a prompt, so a stranger's comment starts nothing. The draft step's token can only read, so it can't push (awml #26)

Decided in #160's follow-up: a try drafts from the issue's text as it reads now, only if it hasn't been edited since the build label was last added, by comparing the issue's last edit with the label event. An edited issue waits for a person to add the label again (awml #120)

The build runs no checks of its own. It pushes and opens the pull request, CI judges it, and the fixer wakes for failed tests or Important review findings, fixing that pull request within its two-commit cap (#108, awml#212)
Decided in #160's follow-up: one new comment when the build starts, linking the run. It's never edited or parsed. The pull request links to the issue by Closes #n (#160 rule 5)
Only a page the change alters is pictured, in a registry filled by scripts/seed-pictures.ts, and the push job checks every picture. A moving image only for something that moves

The description is Claude's note, escaped, then what changed, the decisions the issue didn't settle, the pictures, and Closes #n. No record line and no digests: nothing reads the description back (#160)
The branch is reused, so a new try's push updates the open pull request, and no earlier one needs closing (#160's follow-up)

The build works as the fixer does. A draft touching .github/ or Claude Code's own settings, .claude/, .mcp.json or a CLAUDE.md, isn't pushed: it's offered in a new comment, and the build stops, since nothing is pushed for CI to judge. No session loads settings or servers from the tree
GitHub starts other workflows from the app's pull request, but not from the Actions token's, so CI runs when the pull request opens
